repos_data.description: Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.

🎙️ An intelligent voice productivity assistant that turns speech into clean text, useful actions, and structured knowledge. It helps users capture ideas, communicate naturally, automate repetitive tasks, and stay productive across different apps and workflows.
Voice-to-text dictation app with local (Nvidia Parakeet/Whisper) and cloud models (BYOK). Privacy-first and available cross-platform.

⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
Spotlight alternative and shortcut toolkit for macOS
Feature-packed native macOS screenshot & recording tool: annotate, auto-redact PII, record GIFs, OCR + translate, scroll capture, beautify, and more. No Electron, no subscription.
hns is a speech-to-text CLI tool to transcribe your voice from your microphone directly to clipboard. Integrate hns with Claude Code, Ollama, LLM, and more CLI tools for powerful workflows.
Always-on context for AI agents: screen capture, OCR, voice, MCP server. Local-first, AGPL-3.0.
A native, local macOS toolbox for screenshots, OCR, measuring, keep-awake, pointer tools, shortcuts, windows, workspaces, voice and MCP.
Fast, private push-to-talk dictation for Apple Silicon Macs — local Parakeet TDT v3, no cloud or telemetry.
Hold Fn key, speak, paste transcribed text. macOS menu bar app.
